dog.description_text:
AGE / WEIGHT: 5.5 years old / 45 lbs

GENDER: Female

ENERGY: Moderate

GOOD WITH: Dogs - Yes, Kids - TBD, Cats - TBD

ABOUT ME: Check back for more information about me soon!

MY FOSTER SAYS: I recently moved into a foster home! Badass will share more as soon.

HISTORY

Lucy was born into rescue and adopted in 2021. She was recently returned when her adopter was no longer able to care for her.

DETAILED PROFILE

We will provide a more detailed profile for Lucy once we get to know more about her!

MEDICAL HISTORY

The dogs in our care are up-to-date on vaccinations, spayed or neutered (when old enough), microchipped, and given a general health check. Immediate medical needs and medical history will be addressed with the adopter prior to adoption. Complete vet records will be sent shortly after adoption.
dog.name: Lucy Liu
